cases.message: @pattern on an args field takes one string
args field "region": invalid @pattern "^[A-Z": error parsing regexp: missing closing ]
cases.note: An args field's pattern is compiled once at load, by the check a concept field's pattern is held to as well (cells/conceptField/pattern), under the same rule id.

cases.message: args field "region": invalid @pattern "^[A-Z": error parsing regexp: missing closing ]
cases.note: An automation's args field is held to the same check at load. The fire-time binder compiled the pattern on the first fire and took one that does not compile as no constraint, so the automation loaded and bound every value its pattern was written to refuse (memql#5426).
